name: Chimp Chase: PvP
summary:
Chimp Chase is a thrilling PVP game that redefines the excitement of the Gorilla Locomotion movement system. Immerse yourself in a one of a kind experience as you choose from an arsenal of primary and secondary weapons. Then, dive straight into the battle zone for intense online PVP battles with other players.

Complete quests to earn ores, which you can then use to purchase a wide variety of stylish cosmetics, allowing you to pimp your chimp's appearance and express yourself on the battlefield.
